en.text: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 不要隐藏不听我的恳求！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你留心聽我的禱告， 不要隱藏不聽我的懇求！

en.text: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

zhSimplified.text: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。 我哀叹不安，发声唉哼，

zhTraditional.text: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。 我哀歎不安，發聲唉哼，

en.text: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

zhSimplified.text: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压； 因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。

zhTraditional.text: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓； 因為他們將罪孽加在我身上，發怒氣逼迫我。

en.text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

zhSimplified.text: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛； 死的惊惶临到我身。

zhTraditional.text: 我心在我裏面甚是疼痛； 死的驚惶臨到我身。

en.text: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

zhSimplified.text: 恐惧战兢归到我身； 惊恐漫过了我。

zhTraditional.text: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身； 驚恐漫過了我。

en.text: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

zhSimplified.text: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子， 我就飞去，得享安息。

zhTraditional.text: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子， 我就飛去，得享安息。

en.text: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 我必远游， 宿在旷野。 （细拉）

zhTraditional.text: 我必遠遊， 宿在曠野。（細拉）

en.text: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必速速逃到避所， 脱离狂风暴雨。

zhTraditional.text: 我必速速逃到避所， 脫離狂風暴雨。

en.text: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！ 因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！ 因為我在城中見了強暴爭競的事。

en.text: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行； 在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。

zhTraditional.text: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行； 在城內也有罪孽和奸惡。

en.text: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

zhSimplified.text: 邪恶在其中； 欺压和诡诈不离街市。

zhTraditional.text: 邪惡在其中； 欺壓和詭詐不離街市。

en.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

zhSimplified.text: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 若是仇敌，还可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。

zhTraditional.text: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我， 若是仇敵，還可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。

en.text: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

zhSimplified.text: 不料是你；你原与我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！

zhTraditional.text: 不料是你；你原與我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！

en.text: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

zhSimplified.text: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜； 我们与群众在 神的殿中同行。

zhTraditional.text: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜； 我們與群眾在上帝的殿中同行。

en.text: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

footnotes.text: 55:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！ 愿他们活活地下入阴间！ 因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。

zhTraditional.text: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！ 願他們活活地下入陰間！ 因為他們的住處，他們的心中，都是邪惡。

en.text: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，我要求告 神； 耶和华必拯救我。

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，我要求告上帝； 耶和華必拯救我。

en.text: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

zhSimplified.text: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹； 他也必听我的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎； 他也必聽我的聲音。

en.text: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

zhSimplified.text: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得享平安， 因为与我相争的人甚多。

zhTraditional.text: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人， 使我得享平安， 因為與我相爭的人甚多。

en.text: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

zhSimplified.text: 那没有更变、不敬畏 神的人， 从太古常存的 神必听见而苦待他。

zhTraditional.text: 那沒有更變、不敬畏上帝的人， 從太古常存的上帝必聽見而苦待他。

en.text: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 他背了约， 伸手攻击与他和好的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他背了約， 伸手攻擊與他和好的人。

en.text: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

zhSimplified.text: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战； 他的话比油柔和， 其实是拔出来的刀。

zhTraditional.text: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心卻懷着爭戰； 他的話比油柔和， 其實是拔出來的刀。

en.text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

zhSimplified.text: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必抚养你； 他永不叫义人动摇。

zhTraditional.text: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華， 他必撫養你； 他永不叫義人動搖。

en.text: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑； 流人血、行诡诈的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑； 流人血、行詭詐的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。
